title: Remove a resource
summary: REST API Development: Remove a resource. Describe what a later GET might return.
introduction: DELETE asks to remove the target resource. A 204 success response has no body.
learningObjectives: Remove a resource with REST API Development
Describe what a later GET might return

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.

blocks.title: Remove a resource
blocks.code:
DELETE /books/1 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test

HTTP/1.1 204 No Content

blocks.text: The status is 204, which deliberately has no content body. A later read must use a separate request.

blocks.title: Expected result
blocks.content: The book is removed; the response body is empty.

blocks.text: Describe what a later GET might return.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not attach a JSON body to a 204 response.
